## Overview.

The SatisAction TM key driver statistical model is a powerful, proprietary statistical methodology used to identify the key drivers of the overall health plan rating and provide actionable direction for satisfaction improvement programs.
This methodology is the result of a number of years of development and testing using health care satisfaction data.
DSS Research has been successfully using this approach since 1997.
